title: The 13th Vanilla Level Design Contest - Trials of the Great Caverns ~ Great Relic Heist
description:
The theme of the Gamma Disc of Knowledge, one of the five great relics in the known universe.

Unlike the VLDC13 entry, this does not include the voice that says "Run, little koopa..." Useful for levels that need a very tense yet slow theme.
